title: service-ai: complete I18nLabelSchema migration for Setup nav labels
body:
`AIServicePlugin` was still contributing Setup App navigation labels using the deprecated `{ key, defaultValue }` i18n object shape, while `I18nLabelSchema` now requires plain strings. This aligns `service-ai` with the post-#1054 label contract and with already-migrated plugins.

- **Plugin migration (service-ai)**
  - Updated `packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` setup navigation contributions:
    - `nav_ai_conversations` label → `'Conversations'`
    - `nav_ai_messages` label → `'Messages'`
  - Removed the last deprecated label-object usage in setup navigation contributions under services/plugins scope.

- **Focused regression coverage**
  - Added an integration assertion in `packages/services/service-ai/src/__tests__/ai-service.test.ts` to verify `setupNav.contribute()` receives plain string labels for AI nav items.

- **Changelog**
  - Added an `Unreleased > Fixed` entry in `CHANGELOG.md` documenting the `service-ai` migration completion for deprecated i18n label objects.

```ts
// before
{ id: 'nav_ai_conversations', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_conversations', defaultValue: 'Conversations' } }
{ id: 'nav_ai_messages', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_messages', defaultValue: 'Messages' } }

// after
{ id: 'nav_ai_conversations', label: 'Conversations' }
{ id: 'nav_ai_messages', label: 'Messages' }
```

## Problem

In `packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` (lines 234-235), the `AIServicePlugin` contributes navigation items to the Setup App using the **old i18n object format** `{ key, defaultValue }` instead of plain strings:

```typescript
// Current (WRONG):
{ id: 'nav_ai_conversations', type: 'object', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_conversations', defaultValue: 'Conversations' }, objectName: 'conversations', icon: 'message-square', order: 10 },
{ id: 'nav_ai_messages', type: 'object', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_messages', defaultValue: 'Messages' }, objectName: 'messages', icon: 'messages-square', order: 20 },
```

This violates the `I18nLabelSchema` change documented in CHANGELOG.md (related to [#1054](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/issues/1054)):

> **i18n: `I18nLabelSchema` now accepts `string` only** — The previous `string | I18nObject` union type has been replaced with `z.string()`. i18n translation keys will be auto-generated by the framework at registration time; developers only need to provide the default-language string value.
>
> **Migration:** Replace any `label: { key: '...', defaultValue: 'X' }` with `label: 'X'`.

All other plugins (`plugin-auth`, `plugin-security`, `plugin-audit`) were already migrated — `service-ai` was missed.

## Required Fix

In `packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts`, change the `setupNav.contribute()` call:

```typescript
// Before:
{ id: 'nav_ai_conversations', type: 'object', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_conversations', defaultValue: 'Conversations' }, objectName: 'conversations', icon: 'message-square', order: 10 },
{ id: 'nav_ai_messages', type: 'object', label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_messages', defaultValue: 'Messages' }, objectName: 'messages', icon: 'messages-square', order: 20 },

// After:
{ id: 'nav_ai_conversations', type: 'object', label: 'Conversations', objectName: 'conversations', icon: 'message-square', order: 10 },
{ id: 'nav_ai_messages', type: 'object', label: 'Messages', objectName: 'messages', icon: 'messages-square', order: 20 },
```

## Additional Tasks

1. **Search the entire codebase** for any other remaining instances of `label: { key:` pattern in navigation contributions or setupNav calls that may have been missed during the #1054 migration.
2. **Run tests** to ensure nothing breaks (`pnpm test` or the relevant test suite for service-ai and related packages).
3. **Update CHANGELOG.md** — Add an entry under a new `## Unreleased` section (or the latest section) documenting the fix:
   - Category: **Fixed**
   - Description: **service-ai: Fix navigation item labels using deprecated i18n object format** — Replaced `{ key, defaultValue }` i18n objects with plain string labels in `AIServicePlugin`'s Setup App navigation contributions, completing the `I18nLabelSchema` migration from #1054.

## 问题分析

你提到的问题是：**`@objectstack/plugin-auth` 贡献的导航项使用纯字符串 `label`，但在运行时被显示为 i18n 对象格式 `{ key, defaultValue }`**。

### 根本原因定位

经过代码追踪，**问题源头不在 `@objectstack/plugin-auth`，而在 `@objectstack/service-ai`**：

1. **`@objectstack/plugin-auth`** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` 第 120-128 行) — ✅ **已正确使用纯字符串标签**：
   ```typescript
   label: 'Users'       // ✅ 纯字符串
   label: 'Organizations' // ✅ 纯字符串
   label: 'Teams'        // ✅ 纯字符串
   ```

2. **`@objectstack/plugin-security`** / **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`** — ✅ 也已正确使用纯字符串。

3. ⚠️ **`@objectstack/service-ai`** (`packages/services/service-ai/src/plugin.ts` 第 234-235 行) — ❌ **仍在使用旧的 i18n 对象格式**：
   ```typescript
   label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_conversations', defaultValue: 'Conversations' }  // ❌ 应为纯字符串
   label: { key: 'setup.nav.ai_messages', defaultValue: 'Messages' }            // ❌ 应为纯字符串
   ```

这违反了 CHANGELOG 中记录的 `I18nLabelSchema` 变更（`string | I18nObject` → `string` only），该变更已在 [#1054](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/issues/1054) 中完成。
